title: The Catholic Talk Show - Videos
description: The Catholic Talk Show with Ryan Scheel, Ryan DellaCrosse, & Fr. Michael Nixon explores a wide range of topics related to the history, theology, and culture of The Catholic Church. The show blends humor, deep discussions, and engaging storytelling to make the faith accessible and relatable to modern audiences. The Catholic Talk Show offers a fresh, insightful, and often humorous take on Catholic life and tradition.
